description: What the main window may ask the shell for, and no other window (ADR 0231): find a server, run the Chips it carries, connect a bridge's card, show a notification and a badge, take a chips:// link, hold a page for its frame, keep a room's folder, say which server runs on this Mac, dim the menus' commands it cannot do, say how large the page is drawn and that it is drawn, hand a link to the browser, and move the window from the strip under its traffic lights. A page in a frame never reaches these: Tauri's invoke key goes to the main frame alone.
